case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 1931 of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.8211 of 2022)
summary: Quashing of further investigation final report; High Court findings improper while reviewing investigation; res ipsa loquitur observations premature; standard: preponderance of probabilities in civil claims vs. criminal beyond reasonable doubt; Motor Vehicles Act Section 166 proceedings require evidence on negligence; criminal abatement due to driver's death; appeal allowed setting aside HC order.
final_judgment: Impugned High Court order dated 31.03.2022 set aside; appeal allowed.
